subject: Present/Absent calls with MoGene ST arrays; qc stats too?

messages.author: e4fd778ca57bac51
messages.subject: Present/Absent calls with MoGene ST arrays; qc stats too?
parts:
I would like to look at present/absent calls and the associated p-values for a set of MoGene ST arrays I'm working on. I normalized the chips using the Aroma vignette, but there are no instructions there for P/M/A calls. Normally, I work with Hgu133plus2 arrays, so my instinct was to try reading the cel files in with ReadAffy and then using mas5calls to extract this data. However, I got this error:
> data.mas5calls=mas5calls(CelData)
Getting probe level data...
Computing p-values
Error in FUN(1:11[[1L]], ...) :
  NA/NaN/Inf in foreign function call (arg 2)

I'm sure there must be a way of getting present/absent calls/pvalues with ST arrays, can someone point me in the right direction?

I was also disappointed that I could not get percent present, average background, or scale factor using qc on these chips; is there an equivalent function for ST arrays?

I cannot seem to find any information about this on the Aroma website or searching through the forums. I greatly appreciate any advice you can offer.
~ Heather Wick

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Present/Absent calls with MoGene ST arrays; qc stats too?
parts:
Hi,

sorry, there is currently nothing in aroma.affymetrix for calling
probes present/absent. For questions on affy::mas5calls(), check with
the Bioconductor mailing list.

Cheers,

Henrik
